messages:
zoe: opened a small PR to correct the /search reference examples. the doc shows `GET /search` with a JSON body containing `query`, but the runtime expects `q` as a query parameter (GET with URL query string). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/758
matt: ah yep that mismatch trips up curl and curl-based tests. also the JS fetch snippet serialises a body for GET which some browsers block. we should switch examples to `GET /search?q=...` and add a POST alternative for large payloads.
docs-bot: PR opened by zoe (docs) - "search endpoint: use q query param, add POST fallback for long inputs, fix JS curl snippets" - CI: pending
liam: small note: OpenAPI has `query: string` param in the schema; update to `q` and add a `deprecated: true` alias for `query` so older clients still map for 14d. also update SDK generator mapping so Go/Java clients pick up `q` correctly.
aria: we should also add both examples in the docs: compact GET variant and POST JSON body for bulk queries. quick examples:
GET (short):
```bash
curl -G "https://api.redwood.com/v1/search" \
  -d "q=how to reduce latency" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
```
POST (bulk):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/search \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries":["how to reduce latency","optimize batching"]}'
```
zoe: added both snippets, updated OpenAPI param name to `q` and left a short migration note: "docs previously showed `query` in body for GET; server accepts `q` and will accept `query` for 14 days for backwards compat." updated the JS SDK snippet to set `params: { q: '...' }` instead of body. standardized code fence languages (bash, javascript, python).
matt: tiny nit: in the example response we previously used `hits.items` but runtime returns `results` top-level. changed response example to `results: [{id:..., score:...}]` and updated schema table.
aria: added a one-liner migration snippet for Go clients to map `query` -> `q` when present. CI passed. ready to merge unless anyone objects.
liam: :thumbsup:
